story.label: About Grade10
story.lede: Backed by MemeStrategy (HKEX: 2440) and powered by 9GAG, Grade10 is expanding from Hong Kong into Mainland China, Korea and beyond, building a connected trading card ecosystem across grading, vaulting, financing, retail and live events.
